title: Finite depth-two power-series extension is a base change from the coefficient ring
statement: Let $B$ be a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], $n>0$, and $T=\operatorname{Spec}(B[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]])$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Let $V\subsetneq T$ be open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], containing every prime whose contraction is not the maximal ideal of $B$. Let $p:E\to T$ be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], etale on $V$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], with every stalk above $T\setminus V$ of depth at least two. There exist a finite morphism $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ and $a:E\to Y$ forming a cartesian square with $p$ and the constants-induced $T\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. No etaleness of $g$ or $p$, nor any point of $V$ above the closed point, is asserted or assumed.

proof.text: Use the punctured coefficient open U and W = t inverse U. Obtain the finite coefficient model g:Y -> Spec B, its boundary depth over U, and the comparison e over W. This comparison needs only the finite etale restriction of p, not its boundary-depth hypothesis.

Identify the power-series ring with the variables-adic completion of the polynomial ring, using Mathlib MvPowerSeries.toAdicCompletionAlgEquiv. Noetherian adic completion is flat over the polynomial ring (Mathlib AdicCompletion.flat_of_isNoetherian); transfer it by Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv. The polynomial ring is free over B; Module.Flat.trans yields flatness over B, so the constants morphism t is flat. At a point of E over the closed coefficient point lying outside V, use the supplied boundary depth. At such a point lying inside V, p is etale there, hence its stalk map is flat; apply the flat local depth formula first to t and then to p to get depth at least two. The closed coefficient stalk is ring-isomorphic to B; applying the same depth formula to this isomorphism transfers hdepth. Thus E has depth at least two above the complement of W. The projection from the pullback of g to Y is flat, so the flat local depth formula propagates the supplied Y boundary depth to every pullback stalk above the complement of W.

Apply uniqueness of finite depth-two extensions on W to p and the pullback projection r. This gives i:pullback g t isomorphic to E, with i.hom followed by p = r. Define a = i.inv followed by the projection to Y. Transport the standard pullback square along i; its compatibility equations follow from hi and the inverse identities.

theorem exists_finite_base_of_power_series_depth_two
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := B) B)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) B))).Opens) (hproper : V ≠ ⊤)
    (haway : ∀ v, (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin n)))) v ≠
      IsLocalRing.closedPoint B → v ∈ V)
    {E : Scheme.{u}} (p : E ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) B)))
    [IsFinite p] [Etale (p ∣_ V)]
    (hboundary : ∀ z : E, p z ∉ V →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B)) (a : E ⟶ Y),
      IsFinite g ∧ IsPullback a p g
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin n))))
